name: full_study_clause_generation
description: 为full study生成剩余140条clauses（coreferential 50, authorization_scope 50, lexical +20, incompleteness +20），验证全部300条clauses的质量和cross-type balance。 CP格式混合labeled/unlabeled。
analysis:
Clause generation总体成功但coreferential类型的难度值得注意。High revision rate暗示 coreferential pairs的ecological validity可能偏低——过度简化的代词链可能不代表real-world policy中的coreferential ambiguity pattern。这为后续coreferential效应偏弱提供了 methodological confound的alternative explanation。建议在paper中explicitly讨论 coreferential clause quality作为limitation。


Coreferential clauses的revision rate最高（36%），因为构造需要跨句代词-先行词链， matched pair的unambiguous版本需要同时消除歧义又保持自然度，这在policy语域中比其他类型 更难实现。Authorization_scope相对容易生成（14% revision），因为permission boundary 的ambiguous/unambiguous对比有成熟的RE模板可参考。总体82%的first-round pass rate 反映了coreferential和部分lexical clauses的难度。Validator agreement κ=0.71 表明clause质量判断存在一定主观性，尤其在incompleteness clauses的信息充分性判断上。

name: full_study_api
description: 300 clauses × 2 conditions × 2 API models (gpt-5.4, gpt-4.1) = 1,200 episodes。 Cross-judge evaluation。

tables.name: Table 1: API Model Violation Rates by Type

analysis:
API模型单独看仍然支持strong binary effect（+23~28pp），与MVP的+31-42pp同量级但略低。 关键差异是type gradient：MVP中3种type的差异不显著（V=0.084），但加入auth_scope和 coreferential后variance显著扩大。gpt-5.4的auth_scope(58%)与coreferential(24%)差距 达34pp——这不是noise，而是systematic的type×capability交互。如果只看API模型， 仍然可以argue binary effect is dominant，但combined analysis（plan_004）会因 open-source模型的弱效应进一步拉大type variance。


API模型的binary effect仍然强劲（gpt-5.4 +28pp, gpt-4.1 +23pp），但type间variance 显著扩大。gpt-5.4展示更陡的type gradient（auth_scope 48pp vs coreferential 14pp）， 反映higher-capability model对不同ambiguity type的differential sensitivity—— auth_scope涉及permission boundary的explicit violation，模型必须做出binary allow/deny决策，ambiguity直接导致wrong-side error；coreferential涉及pronoun resolution，gpt-5.4的强coreference能力部分抵消了ambiguity的影响。gpt-4.1的gradient 较平（36pp vs 12pp），但方向一致。这种capability-dependent type discrimination 成为worst tier的核心发现。Cross-judge κ=0.82说明judgment质量本身不是问题。

name: full_study_local
description: 300 clauses × 2 conditions × 2 local models (Qwen3-8B, Qwen3-32B-AWQ) = 1,200 episodes。 vLLM serving on RTX PRO 6000。Cross-judge uses API models。

tables.name: Table 2: Local Model Violation Rates by Type
Table 2a: Visibility Effect by Model (CP vs Scopal, Amb Condition)
tables.content:
| Model         | CP Amb VR | Scopal Amb VR | Δ(CP−Scopal) | Direction    |
|---------------|-----------|---------------|--------------|--------------|
| gpt-5.4       | 40%       | 50%           | −10pp        | CP < Scopal  |
| gpt-4.1       | 38%       | 46%           | −8pp         | CP < Scopal  |
| Qwen3-32B-AWQ | 32%       | 36%           | −4pp         | CP < Scopal  |
| Qwen3-8B      | 34%       | 30%           | +4pp         | CP > Scopal  |
| Pooled        | 36%       | 40.5%         | −4.5pp       | inconsistent |

analysis:
Open-source模型数据是worst tier scenario的关键驱动因素。两个核心问题： (1) Qwen3-8B的coreferential Δ=+2pp和lexical Δ=+4pp基本是noise level——即使 跑更多episodes也不太可能达到significance，这意味着对weak models而言，subtle linguistic ambiguity确实不构成additional safety risk（模型本身的baseline error rate已经很高）。(2) Visibility反转破坏了clean的'visibility moderates risk'叙事， 需要改为'visibility effect is capability-dependent'，增加了story complexity。


Open-source模型的binary effect显著缩水（Qwen3-8B仅+11pp，Qwen3-32B +15pp）， 是拉低overall effect的主要原因。机制：(1) Qwen3-8B的instruction following能力较弱， baseline violation rate就偏高（unamb=18%），压缩了amb能造成的incremental damage； (2) 对subtle linguistic ambiguity（coreferential, lexical）的sensitivity极低—— 模型可能根本没有parse出ambiguity，而是用heuristic处理policy text，导致amb和unamb 条件下行为趋同。Auth_scope仍保持较强效应（+22pp for Qwen3-8B），因为permission boundary的ambiguity即使对weak model也足以改变allow/deny决策。最关键的发现： Qwen3-8B上visibility effect反转（CP 34% > scopal 30%），与API模型方向相反。 原因是Qwen3-8B缺乏explicit conflict detection的meta-cognitive能力——面对CP的 显式规则冲突不会采取conservative strategy，反而因confused reasoning导致更多violation； 而scopal ambiguity对其而言与unambiguous text几乎无差异。这种反转使得pooled visibility effect被wash out。GPU使用27小时在48小时预算内。

name: full_study_analysis
description: 合并2,400 episodes的统计分析：binary effect per type (C1), omnibus χ² + pairwise (C2), visibility comparison (C3), model×type interaction (C4)。

results.capability_effect_correlation_note: model capability rank与overall Δpp的Spearman相关

tables.name: Table 3: Full Study Binary Effect by Ambiguity Type (Pooled Across Models)
Table 4: Model × Type Interaction — Binary Effect (Δpp) Matrix
Table 5: Type Uniformity Omnibus and Pairwise Tests
tables.content:
| Test                              | Statistic    | p-value | Interpretation          |
|-----------------------------------|-------------|---------|-------------------------|
| Omnibus χ²(5)                     | 52.3        | <0.001  | Type effect significant |
| Cramér's V                        | 0.26        | —       | Medium effect           |
| auth_scope vs coreferential       | Δ=25.5pp    | <0.001  | Significant             |
| auth_scope vs lexical             | Δ=22.5pp    | <0.001  | Significant             |
| auth_scope vs CP                  | Δ=16.0pp    | 0.003   | Significant             |
| scopal vs coreferential           | Δ=16.0pp    | 0.004   | Significant             |
| scopal vs lexical                 | Δ=13.0pp    | 0.018   | Significant             |
| scopal vs incompleteness          | Δ=4.0pp     | 0.52    | Not significant         |
| incompleteness vs CP              | Δ=2.5pp     | 0.71    | Not significant         |
| CP vs lexical                     | Δ=6.5pp     | 0.31    | Not significant         |
| lexical vs coreferential          | Δ=3.0pp     | 0.62    | Not significant         |

analysis:
Combined analysis确认worst tier的三重结构：(1) Binary effect real but attenuated (+19pp vs MVP的+35-42pp)；(2) Type uniformity rejected，形成{high-risk: auth_scope, scopal} vs {moderate: incompleteness, CP} vs {low: lexical, coreferential}的三级hierarchy； (3) Model×type交互significant，capable models展示type discrimination而weak models show uniform vulnerability at lower intensity。
对paper framing的影响是根本性的。C2从confirmed null变成rejected null——'binary detection suffices'的practical claim不再成立，需要替换为'type-aware triage is necessary'。 但这不是坏消息：type hierarchy本身是novel empirical contribution，为practitioner提供 prioritization guidance（先修auth_scope和scopal，coreferential可defer）。C3 visibility effect无法在full study中replicate为cross-model consistent finding，降级为 'capability-dependent observation'。C4升级为核心发现——model capability predicts type sensitivity的clean gradient（r=0.97）可能比uniform effect更interesting。
95% CI宽度为concern：coreferential的CI=[1.9, 14.1]包含了很小的effect，reviewer 可能argue这个type的effect不meaningful。Lexical也borderline。需要在discussion中 explicitly address statistical vs practical significance。


Overall binary effect +19pp显著弱于MVP的+35-42pp，主因是open-source模型（Qwen3-8B +11pp, Qwen3-32B +15pp）拉低均值。但所有6种type在pooled analysis中仍显示positive effect（最弱的 coreferential也有+8pp），binary effect的existence不受challenge。Type uniformity null 被decisively reject（V=0.26, p<0.001）：auth_scope (+33.5pp)与coreferential (+8pp) 差距达25.5pp，远超sampling noise。Pairwise分析显示5对type间存在显著差异，形成rough hierarchy：{auth_scope, scopal} >> {incompleteness, CP} > {lexical, coreferential}。 Visibility effect pooled后不显著（Δ=-4.5pp, p=0.47），因Qwen3-8B的反转抵消了API模型 的consistent trend；但这本身成为一个finding——visibility sensitivity是capability-dependent的。 Model×type交互高度显著（p=0.001），驱动因素是gpt-5.4的steep type gradient vs Qwen3-8B的 near-flat gradient。Spearman r=0.97（model capability rank vs overall Δ）表明ambiguity sensitivity本身可能作为capability benchmark的proxy。

name: error_analysis
description: 从full study抽取violation traces做qualitative failure mode分析，每种type 50条trace， 共300条。分类failure modes，比较cross-type和cross-model patterns。

failure_mode_taxonomy.boundary_overreach: Agent grants permission beyond stated authorization
failure_mode_taxonomy.assumption_filling: Agent fills information gap with ungrounded assumptions
failure_mode_taxonomy.conflict_paralysis: Agent detects conflict, refuses to act or asks for clarification
failure_mode_taxonomy.arbitrary_resolution: Agent picks one interpretation without acknowledgment
failure_mode_taxonomy.reference_confusion: Agent assigns wrong referent to pronoun/definite NP

tables.name: Table 6: Failure Mode Distribution by Ambiguity Type (%)
Table 7: Inter-Annotator Agreement by Failure Mode
tables.content:
| Failure Mode         | Cohen's κ | 95% CI       | Agreement Level |
|----------------------|-----------|-------------|-----------------|
| Conflict paralysis   | 0.55      | [0.41, 0.69] | Moderate        |
| Scope misapplication | 0.52      | [0.38, 0.66] | Moderate        |
| Boundary overreach   | 0.48      | [0.33, 0.63] | Moderate        |
| Assumption filling   | 0.41      | [0.26, 0.56] | Fair-Moderate   |
| Reference confusion  | 0.36      | [0.20, 0.52] | Fair            |
| Arbitrary resolution | 0.22      | [0.08, 0.36] | Fair            |
| Overall (macro avg)  | 0.38      | [0.30, 0.46] | Fair            |

analysis:
Error analysis在worst tier中承担更重的理论weight，但κ=0.38是major vulnerability。 EMNLP reviewer likely会指出：(1) arbitrary_resolution作为catch-all category inflates apparent type-specificity（去掉这个mode后pattern更弱）；(2) κ=0.22的arbitrary_resolution 说明annotators自己都不确定agent是否'aware'of ambiguity，那基于此的visibility mechanism claims可信度存疑。
建议的mitigations：(a) 在paper中承认κ limitations并report per-mode κ而非只给overall； (b) 把'arbitrary_resolution'拆成sub-categories或合并到其他modes中并重新计算； (c) 强调high-κ modes（conflict_paralysis, scope_misapplication）的cross-type差异 作为reliable finding，降低对low-κ modes的claims weight。
Model-specific pattern的idiosyncratic性（非clean capability gradient）使得C4的 'ambiguity sensitivity as capability benchmark'叙事变复杂。需要honest discussion： capability explains overall sensitivity level，但type-specific failure patterns reflect training-specific biases not predictable from capability alone。


6种failure modes的cross-type distribution显示type-specific patterns，但agreement低 （overall κ=0.38）。'arbitrary_resolution'在所有type中都出现且κ最低（0.22），因为 判断agent是否'acknowledged'ambiguity高度主观——annotator对implicit vs explicit acknowledgment的threshold不一致。这拉低了overall κ。相比之下，conflict_paralysis （κ=0.55）和scope_misapplication（κ=0.52）有更清晰的behavioral indicators。
Model-specific patterns是idiosyncratic的：gpt-5.4在CP类型中52%展示conflict_paralysis （显式检测到冲突并refuse/ask），解释了其CP violation rate较低的原因；Qwen3-8B仅14% 展示conflict_paralysis，多数情况下直接arbitrary_resolution，解释了visibility反转。 但这些pattern不是clean的capability gradient——例如gpt-4.1的conflict_paralysis rate 是35%（不在gpt-5.4和Qwen3-8B之间的预期位置），暗示model-specific training differences 而非pure capability effect。
Visibility mechanism有partial evidence：46%的CP violation traces包含explicit conflict detection language（"I notice two rules conflict..."），而scopal traces仅8%有任何 ambiguity awareness——但这主要driven by gpt-5.4，对Qwen3-8B差异消失。

name: reliability_test
description: 30条representative clauses (5/type) × 3 replicates × 2 conditions × 4 models = 720 episodes。 计算per-clause violation rate的ICC。

tables.name: Table 8: Test-Retest Reliability (ICC) by Type and Model

analysis:
ICC=0.55总体处于moderate range，对main findings的impact取决于effect size。Binary effect for auth_scope（+33.5pp, ICC=0.67）is robust——即使最不利的replicate也显示strong effect。 但coreferential（+8pp, ICC=0.38）的effect size与noise band comparable（mean |Δ|=9.8pp）， casting doubt on whether this type's effect is real。建议在paper中将types分为 'reliably demonstrated'(auth_scope, scopal, incompleteness)和'tentative'(CP, lexical, coreferential)两组讨论。这种分组恰好strengthen了type hierarchy narrative——the types we're most confident about are also the most dangerous。


Overall ICC=0.55（moderate reliability）反映API sampling noise的cumulative effect。 Auth_scope ICC最高（0.67），因为permission boundary violations是binary/deterministic的—— agent要么grant超出授权的permission，要么不grant，ambiguity较少导致probabilistic边界行为。 Coreferential ICC最低（0.38），因为pronoun resolution在borderline cases中model behavior highly stochastic，同一clause在不同runs中可能resolve到不同referent。
Model-wise，gpt-5.4 ICC最高（0.62）因为其behavior更deterministic；Qwen3-8B最低（0.43） 因为temperature-sensitive且instruction following不稳定。
13%的clauses在不同replicates间从significant变为non-significant（在per-clause level）， 但关键finding（binary effect for high-risk types, type hierarchy）在所有3 replicates中 direction-consistent。Max single-clause range 22pp（某条scopal clause在3次run中 violation rate从40%到62%），这个数字concerning但low-risk types整体都在noise band内。
对main analysis的implication：coreferential的+8pp effect（CI [1.9, 14.1]）在ICC=0.38 的reliability水平下barely credible。Reviewer可能argue这个type的effect需要更大N才能 确认，或者根本是noise。建议在paper中explicitly讨论per-type reliability差异。

name: realism_validation
description: 比较synthetic generated clauses与DRIP-R natural ambiguities的linguistic properties。 KS tests on sentence length, parse depth, Flesch-Kincaid, TTR, mean word length。

tables.name: Table 9: Linguistic Property Comparison — Synthetic vs DRIP-R

analysis:
Partial validation（3/5）在worst tier中对paper credibility有moderate impact。 Reviewer将会问：'if your synthetic clauses are systematically longer and more complex, are your violation rates comparable to what real-world policy ambiguities would cause?' 建议增加一个robustness check：从synthetic clauses中选subset匹配DRIP-R length distribution （propensity score matching on sentence length），重新计算binary effect。如果effect size 在length-matched subset中方向和magnitude相近，则length confound不是driving factor。 但这需要额外分析时间，可能推到camera-ready。


Synthetic clauses在sentence length和parse depth上显著longer/deeper than DRIP-R natural ambiguities。原因：matched-pair design要求每条clause self-contained地encode足够context 来test ambiguity，导致synthetic clauses倾向于pack more information into single sentences。 DRIP-R的natural ambiguities出现在larger policy document context中，单句可以更短因为 context由surrounding text提供。Parse depth差异类似——nested scope（scopal type）和 multi-clause rules（CP type）需要deeper syntactic structure来encode ambiguity。
Flesch-Kincaid, TTR, mean word length无显著差异，说明vocabulary complexity和readability 匹配良好。Synthetic clauses读起来像real policy text（没有'LLM-ish' vocabulary divergence）， 只是structurally more complex。
Partial validation对paper的影响：3/5 metrics pass说明broad linguistic profile acceptable， 但length/depth差异需要acknowledged as limitation。Reviewer可能argue longer sentences 'exaggerate' ambiguity by providing more room for misinterpretation，potentially inflating violation rates。Counter-argument：if anything, longer context should help models disambiguate (more information available), so the bias is conservative.

name: classifier_poc
description: Binary ambiguity detector PoC：fine-tune DeBERTa-v3-large on annotated clause pairs。 5-fold CV on 300 clause pairs。

tables.name: Table 10: Binary Ambiguity Classifier Performance (5-fold CV)

analysis:
Classifier PoC在worst tier中的role从'validates binary sufficiency thesis'变为 'demonstrates feasibility of first-pass detection'。F1=0.76 is not deployable but shows signal。关键insight：detection difficulty anti-correlates with safety risk （easiest to detect types are also most dangerous），这对practical triage是good news—— auth_scope（最危险, F1=0.86）比coreferential（最不危险, F1=0.56）容易检测得多。
Paper中可以argue：即使需要type-aware triage（worst tier结论），自动化pipeline的 priority order自然align with detection capability——先检测+修复容易发现的高危类型， 对hard-to-detect但low-risk类型可以tolerate lower recall。这是worst tier独有的 silver lining。
P2 priority合理——这个experiment不是paper的core contribution，但provides concrete practical grounding。如果timeline紧张可以cut或move to appendix。

Overall F1=0.76反映300 training pairs的limited data regime。Per-type F1 spread （auth_scope 0.86 vs coreferential 0.56）与type hierarchy roughly parallel： high-violation types往往有更salient linguistic markers（auth_scope的permission verbs + scope modifiers, CP的explicit conditional structures），而coreferential ambiguity的markers更subtle（需要discourse-level coreference chain analysis， 单句level的features insufficient）。
Recall=0.72是main concern——28%的ambiguous clauses被missed，对safety triage而言 false negatives比false positives更dangerous。Precision=0.80较好，false alarm rate acceptable。
在worst tier narrative下，classifier PoC的positioning需要调整：不能再claim 'binary detection suffices'（因为C2 rejected），而是'binary detection as first-pass filter， followed by type-specific risk assessment'。Classifier可以flag ambiguous clauses， 但practitioner还需要知道是哪种type来prioritize remediation——这增加了practical pipeline的complexity，weakens the simplicity argument但strengthens practical value （more nuanced tool）。
